h1.en: Example - Wind Power does not retitle the Electric 60 Concrete Pump cells
h1.zh: 「示例 - 风 功率」并不改写邢台的电动60是 90 kW、40 m³/h 那一页的格子

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for Electric 60 Concrete Pump. The row to open is /products/electric-60-concrete-pump. The output cell is 40 m³/h. HBT60-13.132 is on Diesel 60 and LZ-60. Electric 80 on the same outline is 6000 kg. The order must say 90 kW and which stone row applies. 0.7 m³, the same figure Electric 80 prints, on a different motor. That outline matches Electric 80’s outline, not Electric 80’s 6000 kg or 110 kW. /en/products/electric-60-concrete-pump/ plus the stone row and site voltage, to /en/contact/. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints Electric 60 as 90 kW, theoretical output 40 m³/h, 35 MPa, hopper 0.7 m³, fine stone 200 m / 600 m, 13 mm stone 150 m / 450 m, 24 mm stone 100 m / 300 m, frame 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm and 3300 kg. The section title “Actual Available Power” comes from the source page and does not add a rating. No price is printed on the product page. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints Electric 60 at 90 kW, 40 m³/h, 35 MPa and hopper 0.7 m³. The low-pressure 60 page is 75 kW. Confirm 90 kW on the order.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印出的是邢台的电动60是 90 kW、40 m³/h 那一页的数字。要打开的行是 /products/electric-60-concrete-pump。输送量格是 40 m³/h。同一外形上的电动80是 6000 kg。订单必须写 90 kW 以及适用的石子行。0.7 m³，与电动80印的数字相同，电机不同。HBT60-13.132 在柴油60和 LZ-60 上。这组外形与电动80相同，但不是电动80的 6000 kg 或 110 kW。/zh/products/electric-60-concrete-pump/ 加上石子行和现场电压，发到 /zh/contact/。河北品锦机械（邢台）把电动60印成 90 kW、理论输送量 40 m³/h、35 MPa、料斗 0.7 m³、细石 200 m / 600 m、13 mm 石子 150 m / 450 m、24 mm 石子 100 m / 300 m、外形 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm、3300 kg。节标题「实际 Available 功率」来自来源页，不另加额定值。产品页没有印价格。 河北品锦机械在邢台把电动60印成 90 kW、40 m³/h、35 MPa、料斗 0.7 m³。低压60页是 75 kW。订单上要确认 90 kW。

body.en: For Electric 60 Concrete Pump, the heading “Actual Available Power” does not replace a cell. The output cell is 40 m³/h. 0.7 m³, the same figure Electric 80 prints, on a different motor.

body.en: Electric 60 Concrete Pump is unchanged by the heading “Example - Wind Power”. HBT60-13.132 is on Diesel 60 and LZ-60. That outline matches Electric 80’s outline, not Electric 80’s 6000 kg or 110 kW.

heading.zh: 产生的 风 能量

body.en: Under “Generated Wind Energy”, Electric 60 Concrete Pump contributes only the printed cells in this part. The order must say 90 kW and which stone row applies. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints Electric 60 as 90 kW, theoretical output 40 m³/h, 35 MPa, hopper 0.7 m³, fine stone 200 m / 600 m, 13 mm stone 150 m / 450 m, 24 mm stone 100 m / 300 m, frame 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm and 3300 kg. The photograph is an image from the source page https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/wind-power-d_1214.html.

question.en: Does “Actual Available Power” replace The output cell is 40 m³/h?
question.zh: 「实际 Available 功率」会替换「输送量格是 40 m³/h。」吗？

answer.en: No. The output cell is 40 m³/h remains the printed wording for Electric 60 Concrete Pump.
answer.zh: 不会。输送量格是 40 m³/h。仍是邢台的电动60是 90 kW、40 m³/h 那一页已印的说法。

question.en: Where does HBT60-13.132 is on Diesel 60 and LZ-60 belong on the Electric 60 Concrete Pump row?
question.zh: 邢台的电动60是 90 kW、40 m³/h 那一页这一行里，「同一外形上的电动80是 6000 kg。」放在哪里？

answer.en: It belongs on /products/electric-60-concrete-pump, beside the other printed cells, not under a guessed heading.
answer.zh: 它属于 /products/electric-60-concrete-pump，和其他已印格子在一起，不放到猜出来的标题下面。

question.en: What does “Example - Wind Power” add to Electric 60 Concrete Pump?
question.zh: 「示例 - 风 功率」给邢台的电动60是 90 kW、40 m³/h 那一页增加了什么？

answer.en: It is only the section title taken from https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/wind-power-d_1214.html. It does not add a performance figure.
answer.zh: 它只是取自 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/wind-power-d_1214.html 的节标题，不增加性能数字。
